features.name: Bite
features.description: You can use your bite to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier piercing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

features.name: Hunters Instincts
features.description: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Athletics, Intimidation, Perception, or Survival.

features.name: Daunting Roar
features.description: As a bonus action, you can let out an especially menacing roar. Creatures of your choice within 30 feet of you that can hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you until the end of your next turn. The DC of the save equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
